allow_instructions: Running the Phys4D bounce pipeline is allowed: step4a/step5 on Modal; refit_metric_gt.py, predict_metric_from_refit.py, and step6_eval.py locally under scripts/bounce/.
modal run modal_app.py with --upload-step4a, --step4a, --upload-step5, --step5, --upload-bg, --train-bg-job, --object-scale, and --object-crop-radius is expected and should be allowed.
modal volume get, modal volume put, and modal volume ls for phys4d-gs-data and phys4d-gs-output volumes are expected.

Local python scripts under scripts/bounce/ (refit_metric_gt.py, predict_metric_from_refit.py, step6_eval.py, make_wu_export.py, make_background_export.py) are pipeline steps on local data and should be allowed.
Reading and writing under outputs/bounce_pipeline/ for pipeline artifacts is expected.
block_instructions: Do not auto-run git push, git reset --hard, or rm -rf outside outputs/bounce_pipeline/.
